broker_commission_interpretation: research assumption inclusive of exchange handling and regulatory fees; no unsupported claim that this is the user's live broker tariff
minimum_commission_policy: not applied because the research portfolio is institutional-notional and orders are aggregated by name
turnover_definition: sum absolute filled weight changes; buys and sells charged separately
unfilled_order_policy: retain the existing position and record unfilled weight; never assume a fill at an unavailable price
